label: Apple Mac Studio (M2 Max)
description: Workstation cube with M2 Max (or M2 Ultra), 10GbE RJ45 standard plus Wi-Fi 6E and four Thunderbolt 4 ports.
notes: 10GbE RJ45 (NBASE-T, negotiates 1G/2.5G/5G/10G) is built in on every Mac Studio - the only 10G-capable endpoint in this set. Wi-Fi 6E as the secondary path; the natural host for a 10G access-layer demo.
